text: ὁ κόραξ καὶ ὁ Διναύσαρος ἐμπίπτουσιν εἰς τὸν Ἔμπορον καὶ τὴν Ἐμπορίν. ὁ Ἔμπορος καὶ ἡ Ἐμπορὶς ὀργίζονται.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Korax crashes into Emporos's stall, scattering pottery and goods everywhere
Dinosaur collides with Emporis, knocking over her display of fruits and fabrics
Emporos waves his arms angrily as his merchandise flies in all directions
Emporis looks furious as her carefully arranged wares are destroyed
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit is still clutched by Korax during the collision
